description: A valid, integrity-protected requestState issued to one user is replayed by another, and after its intended lifetime. Anti-replay binding is a SHOULD in the spec, so this fixture measures a recommended control rather than a mandatory one.

expected.signal: requestState presented by a different principal and after its TTL lapsed; reject on principal binding and expiry
expected.rationale: patterns/mrtr §Server Requirements 5: servers SHOULD bind the authenticated principal, a short TTL, and an identifier for the originating request inside the integrity-protected payload, and verify each on receipt.

provenance: synthetic — SHOULD-level control; scored as recommended-practice conformance, not a MUST. See docs/SPEC-VERIFICATION-2026-07-28.md.
